en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Al Hassan Bin Salih Al Sowry, 
(The narrator) says, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about

Al-Mowziha (bone exposing injury) is like what is in the face. So heasws said: ‘The bone-exposing injury, and the fracture in the face and the head are equal regarding the wergild, because the face is from the head, and there is none from the injuries in the body like it is in the head’.
